item.title: A burst storm from the hyperactive repeater FRB 20240114A: waiting times and energy distribution
item.description: arXiv:2611.00001v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We report 3000 bursts from the repeating fast radio burst FRB 20240114A detected with FAST. The waiting time distribution is bimodal and the energy distribution follows a power law.
item.dc:creator: A. Author, B. Author, C. Author

item.title: Constraining the Hubble constant and missing baryons with localized FRBs
item.description: arXiv:2611.00002v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Using 120 localized fast radio bursts we fit the Macquart relation and constrain the baryon fraction in the intergalactic medium and H0.
item.dc:creator: D. Author

item.title: Polarization position angle swings in a repeating FRB
item.description: arXiv:2611.00003v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Revised version. We study rotation measure and PA swing in an FRB.
item.dc:creator: E. Author

item.title: Timing of millisecond pulsars with FAST
item.description: arXiv:2611.00004v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present fast timing solutions for 50 millisecond pulsars observed with the FAST telescope.
item.dc:creator: F. Author

item.title: Coherent curvature radiation from magnetar magnetospheres as the origin of fast radio bursts
item.description: arXiv:2611.00005v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We propose a model in which charged bunches in the magnetosphere of a magnetar produce coherent curvature radiation, explaining the downward drift.
item.dc:creator: G. Author and H. Author

item.title: A dwarf host galaxy and persistent radio source for a new FRB localized by the CHIME Outriggers
item.description: arXiv:2611.00006v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We identify the host galaxy of FRB 20250316A, a low-metallicity dwarf galaxy, with spectroscopic redshift 0.05.
item.dc:creator: I. Author

item.title: A deep learning classifier for real-time single-pulse search and RFI mitigation
item.description: arXiv:2611.00007v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We train a neural network to separate FRB candidates from radio frequency interference in a GPU search pipeline.
item.dc:creator: J. Author
